name: MiraCosta College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take free college classes at your high school or online, before, during or after school. You earn both high school and college credit.
who_can_apply: Students at partner schools in the Oceanside, San Dieguito and Carlsbad districts, plus Cathedral Catholic. You must have finished 8th grade or be 15. You need school and parent permission.
pay_detail: Free. Your high school covers books and materials.
duration: By term. Up to 11 units in fall or spring and 8 in summer. Oceanside Unified: up to 15 and 9.
deadline_text: Interest forms are for the upcoming term. No single deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Talk to your counselor. Fill out the interest form for your school. Then apply to MiraCosta and set up your SURF account. Questions: dualenroll@miracosta.edu.
notes: If your school is not a partner, look at MiraCosta concurrent enrollment instead. You can ask for 10 high school credits for a 3 unit class. Parents cannot see your college records.
